entities.summary: Cardinal Bernard Maciejowski, Ciołek coat of arms, Polish nobleman, starosta, royal standard bearer, statesman and Catholic Church leader; Lutsk bishop, Archbishop of Kraków, Archbishop of Gniezno and Primate of Poland.
